responsibility: Provides hand-written structural `Debug`, `Lift`, `TypeFoldable`, and `TypeVisitable` implementations for assorted rustc `ty`-related types that need custom traversal or rendering behavior beyond derives.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `traits/structural_impls.rs`, which only hand-writes `Debug` for a couple of trait-resolution types, this file is the much broader manual implementation site for structural behavior of `ty`-related types, including custom `Debug`, `Lift`, `TypeFoldable`, and `TypeVisitable` logic.
